attempted_fixes: Removed public service getters that exposed persistence and adapter internals and could bypass profile-scoped service APIs; tests observe state through their fixture.
Reject generation advancement at u64::MAX instead of saturating and reusing a persistence revision; in-memory compare-and-swap also uses checked_add(1).
Use saturating byte aggregation for snapshots and total in-memory store usage so accumulated sizes cannot wrap below quota checks.
Rate-limit diagnostic sink attempts to 128 per 1,000 monotonic milliseconds, track dropped events internally, and report a process-level summary at the next available window.
Added explicit malformed action descriptor acceptance coverage for invalid action IDs, duplicate parameter names, excessive parameter count, and descriptor byte limits.
